247.overview:
Chopper Attack is a helicopter-based third-person shooter game released and published in 1997 by Midway.
The game features numerous missions in various locations; missions include bombing the enemy's bases, escorting Air Force One through dangerous jungle terrain and rescuing prisoners of war.

410.overview: One of the most beautiful golf courses in the world is now one of the most beautiful N64 games. The true physics of golf take the starring role in this ultra-realistic venture into the popular sport. You can customize the characteristics of up to 10 different golfers, including power, putting, recovery, and ability against the wind. Plan your approach, pick a club, get your stance just right, read the wind, decide whether you're going for spin, draw or fade, read the meter to get your power where you want it then swing! The six modes of play at your disposal are Waialae Open, Tournament, Stroke, Skins, Match, and Practice. A truly comprehensive game, WAIALAE COUNTRY CLUB will even calculate your handicap for you for use in later play. Up to four players can have a go in each game, with all stats and results saved to the game's memory. The graphics and player animations are outstanding, the play is seamless and intuitive, and the location just can't be beat. Spend your next vacation in Waialae, golf fans. Just don't expect it to be easy.

411.overview:
"Wave Race 64" is a 1996 racing video game developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 64. It is the second entry in the "Wave Race" series, following the 1992 Game Boy game "Wave Race". Gameplay involves racing a personal watercraft across a variety of courses while manoeuvring around buoys. The game also includes a multiplayer mode in which two players can compete on a selected course. It supports the Controller Pak, which allows saved data to be transferred between game cartridges. The game is presented in a letterboxed 14:9 aspect ratio.

The game was initially conceived as "F-Zero on water" and was intended to feature high-speed transforming boats. These were later replaced by personal watercraft after producer Shigeru Miyamoto concluded that the original concept would not be sufficiently distinct from other games on competing systems. "Wave Race 64" received positive reviews from critics, particularly for its controls and dynamic water environments, and has subsequently been included in lists of highly regarded video games. The game also served as an early showcase for the Nintendo 64's 3D graphical capabilities following Nintendo's earlier 2D-focused titles for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System. It was re-released for the Wii and Wii U through the Virtual Console in 2007 and 2016, respectively, and was added to the Nintendo Classics service in 2022. A sequel, "Wave Race: Blue Storm", was released for the GameCube in 2001.

412.overview:
WCW Backstage Assault is a professional wrestling video game by Electronic Arts. It was the final World Championship Wrestling (WCW) game released before the company was purchased by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF).

WCW Backstage Assault takes over 50 WCW wrestlers out of the ring and into real-world venues like a locker room, garage and a loading dock. Traditional wrestling moves can be used, but weapons like two-by-fours and trash cans are also thrown into the mix. By working your way through the game's various modes, you can unlock additional wrestlers, areas and weapons. Bobby Heenan and Tony Schiavone provide the commentary with over 8,000 lines of dialogue.

413.overview: A terrorist group calling itself the Crying Lions is about to take over the world with its mighty satellite and Jean-Luc Cougar is the only one who can stop it. As Jean-Luc, a covert operative working for the Strategic Covert Actions Team, you are responsible for taking back a Lions-controlled base and regaining power of the satellite. Some of the weapons you'll have to acquire and use to defeat the terrorists are handguns, shotguns, and machine guns, though you'll also need to access such materials as explosives, detectors, flashlights and medical kits in order to succeed. A refreshing take on the traditional action game, WINBACK requires as much stealth and strategy as it does reflexes and use of weaponry. The game features six different multiplayer modes, supporting up to four players: Death Match, Lethal Tag, Quick Draw, Cube Hunt, Team Battle, and Point Match. You select your difficulty level and you can even start off in a Tutorial mode to get the controls down.

414.overview: World Driver Championship allows players to develop a racing career as they compete for job offers with each of the 15 World Driver Teams. The game features 10 tracks (Sydney, Kyoto, Rome, and others), 20 challenging events spread across two different levels of competition, and over 30 exotic cars. The game strives to imitate realistic physics and car handling.

415.overview: Now featuring over 40 of your favorite WWF superstars! Customize your own wrestler's move sets and costumes. Over 20 game modes including all-new specialty matches. Real-life WWF entrances and theme songs. Wrestle your way to the title in an all-new career mode. First ever Create-Your-Own Pay-Per-View Mode! Two-man commentary featuring Shane McMahon and Jerry "The King" Lawler.

416.overview: Jump into the ring with the biggest, baddest jambronis around and experience brutal WWF action never before seen in a console game! Over 65 WWF superstars, all-new Ladder matches, and all-new Double-Team moves, like the Dudley 3D Deathdrop! Take on the entire Federation in Survival Mode. Take the action out of the ring in 10 different backstage areas!

417.overview: The greatest wrestling game ever created! Tons of game modes, including Cage Match, Road to Wrestlemania, Create a PPV, and more! Create and bet WWF Championship belts with your friends. Over 50 of the top WWF superstars, more than any other WWF game! Thousands of signature moves, taunts, and mannerisms. New Create a Wrestler, with custom moves, costumes, and fighting styles!

1110.overview:
Save the World... Singlehanded! 

The Kingdom's peaceful world has been shattered! The wizard, while mixing potions with his magical gloves has caused a huge explosion, turning him instantly to stone and dislodging the seven crystals that give the Kingdom its energy. Without the crystals, the castle and its world will fall apart and the wizard will be lost! 

It's down to Glover, one of the magical gloves, to find the crystals, now disguised as rubber balls, and return them safely to the castle. Guide Glover and the balls through seven magical worlds full of puzzles and hidden surprises. Watch out! The evil glove is lurking in the shadows and he'll stop at nothing to foil Glover's attempts at restoring peace.

1214.overview: Winnie the Pooh needs YOU! How can he throw a party without honey? Play as Tigger and run, jump, and bounce around the 100 Acre Wood in search of Pooh's "most favorite" snack. Along the journey there'll be plenty of challenges - blustery blowing leaves to ride, icy terrain, falling boulders, menacing bees, pesky bats and more. Earn Tigger's very special "Tiggertastic Bounce" as a bonus!

1231.overview: War Gods is a one-on-one fighting game that takes place in 3D environments. The fighter under your control can perform many different moves, and string those moves together to perform "combos." Furthermore, the fighters all have special "finishing moves" that eliminate your opponent in some gruesome manner at the end of a match. There are 10 different fighters to choose from, all based on different ancient civilizations.

1232.overview: Tear up the ice with "The Great One", and experience lightning-fast skating, blistering one-timers and hard-hitting body checks! Hammer the puck and rip the net... with the world's best! NHLPA and NHL license means real players, team names, logos, and uniforms. Includes all 26 teams, each with 17 available players in their actual NHL lines. Real-time rendered 3D environment with 7 user-selectable cameras allowing players to view the action from all possible angles. Wayne's hockey strategies, skating moves and logic are incorporated into the AI engine.

1233.overview:
WCW Mayhem is based on Ted Turner's hit cable wrestling league World Championship Wrestling. The game takes many of it's wrestlers and combines them with authentic moves, settings, and actual events found on the various cable programs and pay-per-view specials.

"Mayhem" is probably an accurate word to describe the first wrestling game from Electronic Arts. A TV-style presentation features play-by-play commentary along with signature entrances enhanced by pyrotechnics and theme music. Over 50 professional wrestlers from World Championship Wrestling are included, although you'll need to play through the "Quest for the Best" mode to unlock them all.

1234.overview: Go for the gold, as you take on the Superstars of WCW and the NWO in Singles, Tag Team or Battle Royale competition! Set the stage - Fight in arenas from WCW's biggest events, including WCW Monday Nitro, Starrcade, and Halloween Havoc. Plus, TONS of hidden arenas, secret "run-in" characters, Nitro theme music, and brawling in and out of the ring! Who's next? You are, when you step into the ring with WCW Nitro, the fastest wrestling game to hit your N64! Take control of over 60 WCW and NWO Superstars! Dozens of devastating moves per wrestler, including trademark maneuvers, taunts, and finishers!

1235.overview: Over 40 wrestlers in all, including over 20 WCW and NWO superstars like Hollywood Hogan, Sting, The Giant, Lex Luger, Ric Flair, The Outsiders and many more! Each wrestler is capable of performing 30 to 40 moves, including his own signature moves! Featuring five different gameplay modes, Tag Team and simultaneous four-player action!

1236.overview: More than 60 wrestlers, including ALL of the top WCW and NWO superstars! Awesome new features including wrestler entrances, all the real WCW belts, hidden weapons, instant replay, completely updated roster and complete user stats and arcade style scores! Enjoy real pay-per-view arenas, 40-man Battle Royale mode, and a costume editing feature!

1237.overview: A rainstorm so fierce, it will keep you from leaving your home for the next six months. Wetrix just might be the most addictive puzzle game of all time. Using randomly shaped 3D blocks as they fall from the sky, you must create a series of lakes and dams before the heavy rains appear. Because if the water drains, you lose! Sound simple? Well, mix in a few natural disasters and bomb attacks, and suddenly you need to muster all your strategy and skill to combat nature's fury!

1238.overview: WipEout 64 was released by Psygnosis as a follow-up to the racing game WipEout XL, taking place one year later in 2098. Like in previous installments players control highspeed hovercrafts, pick up weapons to damage the opponents' vehicles and try to finish the race in the first position. In many aspects, the gameplay is pretty similar to its predecessor, such as selection of hovercrafts, visuals or the handling system. Beside new racing tracks the main differences include a Split-Screen Multiplayer Mode (up to four players), Weapon & Super Combo Challenges as well as various Special Weapons for each Team!

1239.overview: Win the World - For Your Country! All 32 World Cup France 98 qualifying teams: Take your team, with all your favorite players, to the World Cup Final and win it all. NEW! World Cup Classics: Play 8 of the all-time most thrilling World Cup Final matches. NEW! On-the-fly in-game management: Alter attacking strategy and formation at the press of a button. NEW! On-the-fly in-game tactics: Run preset plays at critical points in the game.

1240.overview: 'Dis ain't no fishing game. The ultimate test of strategy pits worm vs. worm throughout 44 missions for 1 - 4 players. Ignite 41 special weapons, like highly flammable old ladies, bouncy banana bombs, and flying sheep, as you inch your way to victory. Devise wickedly ingenious strategies so that your army of worms can wipe THEIR army of worms right off the planet! Over-the-top action and an endless supply of multi-player modes make Worms Armageddon the perfect strategy game!

2759.overview: The game features seven basic gameplay modes, allowing configurations of one to four players. These include training mode, one-on-one, tag team, cage match, weapons match, tornado tag team, and war (elimination free for all). Two additional modes, Royal Rumble and gauntlet, are exclusive to the Nintendo 64 version. The player can also create and customize his own wrestler, taking him through the WWF challenge. The new wrestler finds himself at the bottom of a pyramid, and has to challenge wrestlers situated immediately above him, gradually working his way through to the title. Sometimes previously defeated wrestlers will challenge the player to a "grudge match", which usually consists of special encounters, such as battles with weapons or cage matches.

2769.overview:
This game is an interactive version of the popular U.S. quiz show Wheel of Fortune complete with hostess Vanna White.

The game is played by trying to find a hidden word with only a few guesses allowed for the letters which is very similar to the pen and paper game Hangman. The other round which features the Wheel of Fortune involves you spinning the wheel which has various prizes both good and bad and whatever the pointer stops on when it stops revolving is what the player wins. This can be cash, a free spin or if you're very unlucky Bankruptcy which means you lose all the money you've earned up to that point.

Up to 3 Players can play together in multiplayer mode.

2773.overview: Take on "The Great One" again in this hot sequel to the smash hit voted "Best Sports Game" of '96! With more great features, such as new hidden teams and improved, hard-hitting AI, Gretzky '98 packs a wallop! Includes all 26 teams, each with 17 available players on their actual NHL teams, and you can make player trades or line manipulations to create a powerhouse team of your own. Play 3-on-3, 4-on-4 or 5-on-5 games on either arcade or regulation size hockey rinks, plus exhibition games, full 82 game seasons or a best-of-seven playoff series with full statistic saving capability.

22602.overview:
Wonder Project J2 is a Japanese exclusive Nintendo 64 game released in 1996 as a sequel to the 1994 Super Famicon game Wonder Project J. Wonder Project J2 was developed by Givro and published by Enix.

The game takes place 15 years after the events of the first game and focuses on the protagonist Josette - a female robot built by Doctor Geppetto who built the main character of the previous game as well. The game plays as a raising simulator, with the player guiding Josette through the text driven game through yes or no questions in a branching but limited story line. Choices made in the early game effect the outcome of the second half as Josette and by proxy the player come into conflict with the Silliconian Army.

95725.overview:
Wildwaters (also know as “Extreme Kayak” and “X-Stream”) is a cancelled racing game that was in development by Looking Glass Studios for the Nintendo 64 in 1998 / 1999. The project was announced at E3 1999 by Ubisoft (that was interested as a publisher) while the studio was working on Destruction Derby 64 (published in the same year), but sadly it was never finished.

Wildwaters 64 was very promising as Looking Glass were able to create an engine with real physics running for the waterflow through the river on an N64, but it needed more time and love which eventually ran out. Five different gameplay modes, including Arcade, Time Trial, Championship, Finals and Versus Battle were planned for the game.

Some months later, on May 2000, Looking Glass Studios went out of business during a financial crisis related to their publisher at the time, Eidos Interactive. Wildwaters / Extreme Kayak vanished forever, along with their other promising N64 racing game, Mini Racers.

There was another cancelled water racing game titled “Wild Water World Championships” that was planned for the Nintendo 64, but it should not be confused with this one as WWWC was developed by Promethean Designs.

155244.overview: Waluigi has gambled himself into bankruptcy.  In order to pay for his rent, there is only one solution, selling tacos! And not just regular ones, help Waluigi cook the tacos that will give the most profit for this unique adventure.  Bon apetit!

174853.overview: This is a re-release of WaveRace 64 Kawasaki JetSki with added Rumble Pak features. Part of the Japan-only Shindou Edition series.

419816.overview: WCW Feel the Bang! is an extensive ROM hack of WWF No Mercy for the Nintendo 64, created by a large group of modders and posted on the AKI Live forums. The game acts as a fan-made sequel to WCW/nWo Revenge. It features a very large cast of wrestlers, many WCW arenas, custom movesets, and an unlock system.

420309.overview:
WWF No Mercy Plus is a ROM hack of WWF No Mercy for the Nintendo 64, created by RetroRandyPrice along with contributions from @thejordyad. The mod aims to improve the base version of No Mercy in several ways, including:

* Big Show replaces Steven Richards (Richards is moved to another slot)
* Full wrestler entrances
* Improved quality entrance themes, along with 17 additional entrance songs
* Move additions, including the Rock's Sharpshooter and Kurt Angle's Ankle Lock

Version 1 was released in July 2023, with plans for additional versions in the future.

420797.overview:
WWF LEGENDS is a complete modification of the beloved Nintendo 64 video game "WWF No Mercy" originally released in 2000 and widely regarded as one of - if not the best professional wrestling simulation ever created. The AKI (now Syn Sophia) Development team were able to take the colorful and unique world of professional wrestling and lovingly port it directly into their multiple titles for the Playstation and Nintendo 64 throughout the late 90s/early 2000s culminating in this game, the final release of its kind. Because of its reputation as the "gold standard" in pro-wrestling gaming, and made stronger by the sudden stop in production, wrestling and video game fans alike have longed for more of the signature action and quirkiness AKI games provided.

By that same token, the World Wrestling Federation (now WWE) was king of the world of professional wrestling in the mid-80s well into the 90s. Dubbed the "Golden Era," the colorful characters, legendary performances, pop-culture crossover success and indelible childhood memories created in this time period has left a generation of fans clamoring for a way to relive the glory days of the WWF.

WWF LEGENDS aims to fill both of these voids and appeal to multiple generations by updating and evolving the AKI game engine while capturing the essence of the World Wrestling Federation's golden age. The marriage of these two worlds almost serves as a spiritual successor to "WWF WrestleFest" - the classic arcade title that fans of the era will certainly remember. This is all made possible through emulation - WWF LEGENDS runs on Project64, an emulator available for your PC. A variety of other tools help create the immersive experience including custom music, match commentary & more.

421094.overview: WCW Saturday Night is a ROM hack of WWF Wrestlemania 2000 for the Nintendo 64. The mod covers the early 1990's of WCW wrestling and includes an entirely new roster, along with custom arenas and newly added themes/music.

422654.overview:
WCCW 64 is a free mod of the Nintendo 64 videogame WWF No Mercy.
It is based on the entire lifespan of the 80's Wrestling organization World Class Championship Wrestling.

424471.overview: WWF WarZone 64 is a ROM hack of WWF No Mercy. The concept is envisioned as AKI, the original creators of No Mercy, undertaking WWF WarZone. The game features custom arenas, superstars from the '98 era, training rooms, and hi-res textures.

447522.overview:
WWF Wrestlemania X 64 is a total conversion of WWF Wrestlemania 2000 N64, with the premise of  "What if there was a WWF AKI game released in the early 90's that was based on the rosters of the 16 bit games?"

List of changes: 

* All characters moves, stats, appearances changed
* All music changed
* All Arenas changed
* Intro animation changed
* All Tag Team entries changed
* Spotlights, Fireworks, Fire on all entrances altered
* All Titantrons changed
* Menu graphics changed
* Entrance music plays on title and in match instead of midi music
* Moves imported
* Story mode text changed
* Introduction cutscene edited.
* Title belt graphics and info changed
* Hints added to title screen
* Select backgrounds for wrestlers match
* Power bar graphics changed
* Font changed to VPW2 font

450439.overview:
This is a slightly unfinished Wario moveset based off of Wario World that I'm working on for a Wario Land 64 mod I want to make. It's missing the wild swing ding from Wario World and picking up nearly every enemy in the game like in Wario Land 1-5. I might update this from time to time and improve it.

Credit to FluffaLuigi for the Wario model that I extended for this mod.
Made with HackerSM64.

458822.overview:
It is a shitty time.
The harvests are poor, and monsters roam freely across the land.
Chosen by lot, warriors are trained from birth in the mystic artes.
A warrior must be learned in cunning, strategy, and swiftness for their final lonesome trial when they come of age.
To prevail as a warrior is to scale the Demon's Spire, lair of the Shadow Queen.
Many have entered,  but few have returned.
If one prevails over the trial,
if one succeeds at their task,
they shall be known as a Wizard of the Board.

Wizard of the Board is my submission to the second N64Brew Game Jam. It was made over the course of two months and runs on a retail Nintendo 64. The theme for the game jam was "control". My natural answer to that was first-person voodoo chess.

You can play the game with a Nintendo 64 flashcart. Most emulators should work too, such as Ares or mupen64plus.

The premise of the game involves Zatt, a young warrior-in-training. Zatt aims to scale the Demon's Spire and become a Wizard of the Board. Or, at least he thinks he does.

458868.overview:
WCW vs. nWo: 9 Underground is a ROM hack of WCW vs. nWo - World Tour, created by RagDas. In his own words:

"Here's my second ROM hack of WCW vs. nWo: World Tour, titled "WCW vs. nWo: 9 Underground". This time around, it's quite simple to summarize what was achieved: 9 wrestlers, as the name suggests, have been added to the playable roster without removing anyone from the existing roster. It is known among a few people who have explored ROM hacking World Tour that the moveset and params data for entire playable roster of VPW64 is contained within World Tour, though for characters that didn't make the final roster of World Tour, their movesets are in various states of completion. This hack has taken 9 of these incomplete characters and given them full functionality."

460003.overview:
The Hogan Era is over. The muscle-bound giants are fading. What rises in its place is faster, rawer, more personal, and it’s all here in WWF Eras: The New Generation, the second game in the series.

Rather than a traditional front-loaded roster dump, this game is built around a pod-based system. Each pod is headlined by a major WWF superstar of the time, and surrounded by their greatest rivals, allies, and storyline-specific matchups, giving you a fully immersive timeline from WrestleMania IX to the dawn of the Attitude Era.

This is the era of Bret Hart, The Undertaker, Shawn Michaels, Diesel, Razor Ramon with new blood rising from every corner. Each pod tells a story. Each rivalry can be played. Every feud you remember (and some you forgot) is in your hands.

About WWF ERAS: The New Generation

Unlike a typical front-loaded roster dump, The New Generation is thoughtfully built around a Pod System where each pod is centered on a featured superstar from the era. These pods are timeline-accurate and organized by key rivalries, storylines, and affiliations that defined WWF from 1993–1997.

From Bret Hart’s legendary battles with Owen Hart and Jerry Lawler, to Razor Ramon’s Intercontinental title wars, to Shawn Michaels’ rise to the boyhood dream, this game lets you relive the entire arc of the New Generation through carefully curated rivalries and character matchups.

Each pod feels like its own chapter in WWF history, making this more than just a game... it’s an actual playable timeline.

470271.overview:
A mysterious world where those devout to dorrie live. Unique takes on what it means to be a "water level", or just a mario level in general, are presented as your skills are put to the test. Explore 3 traditional style, and 4 new experimental levels where water does not act like it normally does.
Made for the first iteration of the scuttle rom hack competition, where each participant only had 56 hours (7 days) to create a 30 star hack. This hack was not judged with the rest of the hacks as it was created by the competition organizer.

470278.overview: One day, Mario recieved a strange package from his good buddy, Wario. The package contained a rude letter, along with a folder of several weird drawings and photos. Looks like Wario's up to no good - can Mario find the stolen Stars with Wario's Hints? And what's he up to, anyway?

470310.overview:
26 years later, the long awaited sequel to WWF No Mercy has arrived, courtesy of RetroRandyPrice.

WWF Backlash is an extensive ROM hack of No Mercy, with many new features, including:

* New wrestlers, each with their own trons and entrance themes
* New arenas
* New match types, such as Hell in a Cell, Multi-man Cage and Barbed Wire matches
* New moves
* New gameplay mechanics, such as tossing over the top rope, and powerbombs over the top rope

Play out the Invasion angle in all it's glory. Backlash has arrived!

470752.overview:
This is a total conversion of WWF Wrestlemania 2000 for N64 as what originally started as a project of "what if AKI released WWF WarZone instead of Acclaim". It has turned into the teams love letter to such a popular time period in wrestling fans' minds.

WHAT HAS CHANGED FROM ORIGINAL WWF WM2000
----------------------------
- Wrestlers moveset, stats, appearances changed
- Entrance Music changed
- All Arenas changed
- Intro updated
- All Tag Team entries changed
- Spotlights, Fireworks, Fire have been reworked to be as fitting as possible. 
- Menu graphics changed
- Moves imported
- Story mode text changed
- Title belt graphics and info changed
- Hints added to title screen for unlockables
- Match graphics changed
- In Game menus and Graphics Changed

472645.overview: Revenge with entrance music. No other changes aside from ROM, RAM and file table expansion for modders.

472809.overview:
This is an unofficial, fan-made, not-for-profit fan modification of WCW/nWo Revenge on the N64, fully compatible with Emulation, Summercart, Everdrive, and Console. 

Texture upgrades, fictional stables & wrestlers replaced, new characters added/roster expanded, over 200 ported and custom move/taunt animations, every playable character now has 4 unique, real attires, and custom sound effects/announcer clips.

474362.overview: WrestlePalooza 64 refers to a popular community mod/ROM hack of the classic Nintendo 64 game WWF No Mercy. It upgrades the legendary AKI game engine with massive roster updates, high-resolution textures, custom entrance music, and improved Artificial Intelligence (AI) for more competitive and fluid in-ring matches.

476135.overview:
WWF Prime Time Wrestling is a total conversion of WWF WrestleMania 2000 for the Nintendo 64.

What began as a single project celebrating WWF's Golden Era grew into a dual release (along with WWF Saturday Night's Main Event). The projects were built from GM Spectre's WWF WrestleMania X SK 1.2 base and were strongly influenced by the WWF Legends Challenge 64 texture hack.

476137.overview:
WWF Saturday Night's Main Event is a total conversion of WWF WrestleMania 2000 for the Nintendo 64.

What began as a single project celebrating WWF's Golden Era grew into a dual release (along with WWF Prime Time Wrestling). The projects were built from GM Spectre's WWF WrestleMania X SK 1.2 base and were strongly influenced by the WWF Legends Challenge 64 texture hack.

481664.overview:
* Restored CAW Slots (WCW Saturday Night SK 1.2 has 7 caw slots, remastered restores all 16)
* 18 New Wrestlers (in addition to base WCWSN SK1.2 roster, a first for a WM2000 romhack)
* New Main Menu & Edit Mode BGMs
* 80 new selectable entrance theme songs (110 themes total now)
* Several new parts for CAW makers to make wrestlers that didn't make the cut
* Upgraded graphics for all wrestlers, including new face textures and new/upgraded attires
* ‘98 Tag Title replaced with era appropriate tag title. US Tag Team titles added
* Handful of new moves and very very minor moveset changes
* And more!

482034.overview: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time: Whomp's Fortress is a compact, fan-made ROM hack that perfectly transposes the iconic second stage of Super Mario 64 into the Ocarina of Time gameplay engine. Playing as young Link, you navigate the familiar floating fortress using traditional Zelda mechanics, substituting Mario's platforming and Power Stars for puzzle-solving, combat, and item-based exploration. The mini-dungeon challenges players to explore every vertical layer of the map to discover a hidden key, unlock a secret room, and track down 10 Golden Skulltulas for 100% completion.

482606.overview: Hulkamania 64 brings together the full rosters from WWF Saturday Night’s Main Event and WWF Prime Time, along with several Federation-era superstars who were missing from both games. It also restores more than 20 wrestlers from GMSpectre’s WWF WrestleMania X hack. That means more legends, more matchups, and plenty of room to recreate your favorite years of the WWF.

482608.overview:
WWF Monday Night RAW is a total conversions of WWF WrestleMania 2000 converting the game to reflect the early days of Monday Night RAW.

– Updated wrestler move sets, statistics and appearances
– Updated entrance music
– Replaced arenas
– Expanded Create-a-Wrestler selections, including faces, facial hair, front hair and masks
– Updated tag-team entries
– Imported additional moves
– Rewritten Story Mode text
– Updated championship belt graphics and information
– Added title-screen hints for unlockable content
– Updated match graphics
– Updated in-game menus and graphics
– Weights and Heights have now been fixed
– Intro Skip added to avoid Intro sequence crash
– Improved Voiceovers for pin
– Championship belts now show on all 4 wrestler attires not just the attire that won the championship
